source_assumptions:
theorem empiricalMean_minimizes (y : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (u : ℝ) :
    (∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, (empiricalMean y n - y t)^2) ≤
      ∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, (u - y t)^2
